runs.content: UnitedHealth was bought after its third FY26 guidance raise (adj EPS at least $20.50) on a Q3 beat and an improving medical cost ratio (88.4%); the +5% gap faded to a flat close, so the entry is at the pre-print price. CVX hit T1 at $217.73 (+25.12%, 1/3 sold for ~$417). IAG was exited as a capacity trim (−4.00%, −$40; weakest position, no thesis break). Portfolio net P&L: +$2,041 (+2.62% on $78,000).

Build-A-Bear at ~6x earnings and a ~3.6% yield near its 52-week low, a direct Burry long whose new CEO is reversing the pre-made plush push. LMT was exited as a capacity trim (−4.53%, −$45; weakest position, no thesis break). No stop/T1/T2 triggers; RIGL is $1.52 and CVX $2.51 from T1. Portfolio net P&L: +$2,067 (+2.68% on $77,000).
